_notes: Sheet 331 of the tournament savegame (8x4), read card by card from the image on 2026-10-28. CardID = 33100 + idx; 33200 = character card (sheet 332). The loose deck cards carry keys 187/188 of the original mod with the same images: the identity is the FaceURL, the number comes from the deck's DeckIDs (same criterion as Hellboy, 19700).
Fighter restrictions and copies from the TTS sheet (unmatched-memory does not have them): Baba Yaga 16, Koschei 2 (Death's Release), ANY 12.

Discrepancies with unmatched-memory (the card wins; entries with `text` overwrite the importer's text): Deathless says 'Baba Yaga' (not 'Baba Yaha'); Pact Of Mortality says 'health' (not 'healt'); Read The Bones says 'Randomly put the rest on the bottom'; the ability has no '!'. The five Pacts have an ONGOING paragraph and the discard condition that unmatched-memory omits.

Koschei: 1 token (Custom_Token e0c176 in the save), life 3, melee, movement 2 (the hero's). Starts on the board (1 on the board, 0 in reserve) on the player's start space; returns with Deathless or Pact Of Mortality with life 3. Baba Yaga is a standee (Custom_Assetbundle 3de904); dials ae0f05 (Koschei) and dec0a9 (Baba Yaga).
No forms or counters. The FATEFUL BARGAINS ability is an optional data passive (redirect_effect_damage): until the effects interpreter reads it, the engine does not apply it.
